title: A directory report
description:
Walk a folder and report sizes with `std::fs` and `std::path`.

```
report/
  a.txt        12 bytes
  data/
    b.csv      37 bytes
    c.csv       8 bytes
3 files, 57 bytes, largest: data/b.csv
```
hints: `let mut entries: Vec<_> = fs::read_dir(dir)?.collect::<Result<_, _>>()?; entries.sort_by_key(|e| e.file_name());` (lesson 7.04).
`entry.metadata()?.is_dir()` decides whether to recurse; `metadata.len()` is the size. `path.strip_prefix("report")` gives the relative name.
requirements: Create a small folder tree at the start with `fs::create_dir_all` and `fs::write`.
A recursive `fn walk(dir: &Path, depth: usize, out: &mut Vec<(PathBuf, u64)>) -> io::Result<()>`; sort entries by name so the output is stable.
Use `?` for every I/O call and print a helpful message if `main` gets an error.
stretch: Add a `--ext csv` filter read from `std::env::args`.
